title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Civility and Social Media
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: After a stressful settlement meeting, a paralegal posts on their Facebook page: "Opposing counsel John Doe is the most unethical, sleazy practitioner in Ontario." Assuming this is false and merely a vent, this constitutes:
options: A breach of the duty of civility and good faith.
Protected Charter speech that the LSO cannot regulate.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 demands courtesy, civility, and good faith toward all persons. Making disparaging, insulting, and unprofessional comments about opposing counsel publicly on social media clearly breaches the duty of civility.
